Volatility & Risk Assessment

Historical drawdowns represent the peak-to-trough decline in closing price. Major macroeconomic events have consistently driven peak volatility and significant drawdowns in AXP's history.

Key Drawdown Episodes:
  • Worst On-Record Drawdown: The overall maximum drawdown reached -83.91% around 2009-03-06.
  • 2008 Financial Crisis: During the global financial crisis (2007-2009), the maximum drawdown reached -83.91%. As a financial services firm, AXP was heavily impacted by credit market stress.
  • 2020 COVID-19 Crash: The market crash in early 2020 resulted in a steep but rapid drawdown of -49.64% as consumer spending and travel abruptly halted.
